Gratuity Calculation Basis

End of Service Gratuity has been calculated automatically based on approved company settings and Saudi labor practice rules configured in the system.

Calculation depends on the following factors:

* Employee service period (from Date of Joining to Relieving Date)
* Last approved salary used for gratuity calculation
* Type of employment / contract
* Reason of leaving
* Minimum eligible service period (if configured)
* Applicable gratuity rules in system settings

Standard Gratuity Rule

* First 5 years of service: Half month salary for each completed year
* More than 5 years of service: One full month salary for each additional completed year

Resignation Rule

If the leaving reason is Resignation, the calculated gratuity amount is adjusted according to service duration as follows:

* Less than 2 years of service: No gratuity entitlement
* From 2 years to less than 5 years: One third of gratuity amount
* From 5 years to less than 10 years: Two thirds of gratuity amount
* 10 years of service and above: Full gratuity amount

Final Amount

The final gratuity amount displayed in this document reflects the applicable rule based on employee service period, leaving reason, salary basis, and approved company settings.

Calculated based on Saudi Labor Law Articles 84 and 85.
